summary: Northern Dynasty Minerals Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 26, 2026, attaching a press release that reports oral arguments were held on June 25 in Alaska Federal District Court regarding its case seeking withdrawal of the EPA's veto of the Pebble Project. The matter is now pending decision. No corporate transaction, capital return, restructuring, or other special-situation event is announced. The filing is a routine legal update on ongoing litigation, not a special situation.
